findings.body: The model guard treats missing telemetry as proof that Sol xhigh ran. `_attempt` only populates `selected` from progress lines, but this check defaults absent values to the required model and effort. A complete report with no such lines is accepted, as the clean stub in `test_7_review_guards_client_signoff` demonstrates. The no-fallback requirement needs positive verification of the model and effort actually used.
findings.title: Not done: A strict review guards sign-off

findings.body: A default-only answer passes this check when its source has trailing whitespace, for example `(our default , 2026-09-28)`. `nextstep.py:57` permits that whitespace and `nextstep.py:92` stores the source without trimming it; `forge next` treats the line as settled. Comparing only `.lower()` here then misses the default source, so a clean review can accept the sign-off despite an explicitly disallowed source.
findings.title: Not done: A strict review guards sign-off

findings.body: The sign-off command test exercises a blocking finding, fallback, default-only source and successful acceptance, but never attempts acceptance with a missing, ask-the-client, later, repeated or malformed must-answer topic. `test_proto_next.py` checks only `forge next`. Replacing the sign-off call to `open_must_answer_topics` with an empty list would therefore leave the sign-off tests passing while removing a required acceptance guard. Add a command-level refusal case for an open topic.
findings.title: Not done: test_7_review_guards_client_signoff open-topic case

findings.body: The review clone uses HEAD, while acceptance reads the answers page from the working tree. If `docs/product/BRIEF.md` is removed from the index with `git rm --cached` and then edited, it drops out of this `product` path list and the later path-limited status check misses it. The reviewer sees HEAD's old page, while the decision quotes and validates the different working-tree page, yet records HEAD as its reviewed commit. Check the answers page explicitly against the reviewed commit.
findings.title: Keep the quoted answers tied to the reviewed commit
